newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T Industries up on newspaper comment.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T Industries up on newspaper comment.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc rose in early trading on Monday after the Financial Times Lex column said it was "hard to justify" their underperformance against Philip Morris Cos Inc this year.
B.A.T shares were up 5-1/2p at 432-1/2 by 0829 GMT.
The FT said Morris shares were near their historic highs but B.A.T remained 27 percent below their January peak.

But it said B.A.T had a "considerable advantage" over Morris in that the UK firm had ring-fenced its financial services activities so even if a tobacco lawsuit was successful, it would have a major business left -- while also easing any demerger. It said the underperformance of the stock gave management an incentive for radical action and raised the possibility of a share buyback even if a demerger was not pursued.
